capabilities: Draw rectangle and polygon covers over labels on images in a folder
Reveal covers progressively by scrolling, grouped by pair number
Mark target regions so labels can be quizzed out of context
Run shuffled cross-diagram quizzes with cropped regions and self-grading
Persist annotations, image order and reveal progress in per-folder JSON files
disambiguation: Not a slide-presentation tool despite the name; it overlays reveal covers on images for flashcard-style self-testing.
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins store; must be installed manually or via BRAT. Annotations are portable across vaults and sync services. The README credits AI assistants (Codex, Claude Opus) writing code under human direction and calls it 'vibe-coded software'.
intentEvidence: It's the thing PowerPoint is bad at: instead of duplicating a slide once for every label you want to reveal
motivation: The author states the plugin exists because there wasn't a good way to do scroll-to-reveal flashcards on labeled images in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no way to study labeled images as flashcards, where each label is progressively uncovered in place instead of duplicating the whole image per reveal step.

relations.evidence: It's the thing PowerPoint is bad at: instead of duplicating a slide once for every label

summary: Flashcard study tool for labeled images: draw covers over labels and scroll to reveal them step by step, with a cross-diagram quiz mode.
